desc: Implement the primary solution in Python: compute f[i] and h[i], build a sparse table RMQ over h, answer each query by binary searching K with rmq(L, L+K-1)+K <= length, and verify on samples.
Verify feasibility transformation and sentinel handling when no valid bottom exists.
Test edge cases: N=2, all equal sizes, no possible pairs, odd/even query lengths, f[i]=N.
If sparse table memory/time is problematic, implement segment tree or sqrt-decomposition RMQ fallback.
